title: Enable TearFree rendering for AMDGPU in Xorg
summary: Reduce screen tearing by enabling hardware page flipping via Xorg configuration or temporary xrandr command.

steps.explain: Identify your display output name (e.g., HDMI-A-0, DisplayPort-0).
Enable TearFree for the specific output. Replace <OUTPUT_NAME> with the name from the previous step.

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the display output (e.g., HDMI-A-0)

alternatives.explain: Permanently enable TearFree by creating an Xorg configuration file.
alternatives.gui: Create /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/20-amdgpu.conf with content: Section "OutputClass" Identifier "AMD" MatchDriver "amdgpu" Driver "amdgpu" Option "TearFree" "true" EndSection

rollback.explain: Remove the configuration file if created.

warnings: Permanent configuration requires creating a file in /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/ and restarting Xorg.
